messages:
Jonas (Support): Heads up — got 3 similar asks from Acme + BetaCorp about per-tenant routing / route aliases. Putting here to decide canonicalization and next steps.
Maria (Product): Thanks. Can we converge these into one canonical request for product backlog: 'per-tenant routing / route aliases'?
Kevin (Sales): @Maria fyi both are enterprise-tier. Acme wants ETA for legal review, BetaCorp is gating on this for an onboarding win.
Maria (Product): Proposal: stitch into a single canonical issue, owner = Maria, priority = P2. Acceptance criteria should include API + Console flow + migration guidance. Any objections?
Anya (Eng): Heads-up: touches routing table + policy service + migrations. Ballpark 2-3 sprints to prototype, 1 sprint to stabilize.
Jonas (Support): For customer comms, do we say "scheduled" or "under review"? Sales needs something a bit firmer.
Maria (Product): Let's be concrete but cautious: say 'Planned and scoped; preliminary ETA Q4. PM will follow up with timeline.'
Maria (Product): Also proposing an automated triage rule so we can link duplicates faster:
```
# triage rule (proposal)
if similarity(title_a, title_b) > 0.85 or same_customer
  link_as_duplicate(canonical_issue)
  add_tag("duplicate-merged")
```
Jonas (Support): That rule would save a lot of manual work. Can we include substring match for key phrases like `route` `tenant`?
Maria (Product): yes — add heuristics for key phrase whitelist. We'll iterate.
triage-bot: RF-2345 created and duplicates linked: ACME-778, BETA-002, INTERNAL-119.
Maria (Product): Decision recap: merge the three asks into RF-2345. Owner: Maria (Product). Priority: P2. Acceptance: API + Console UX + migration docs. Tags: customer-driven, duplicate-merged.
Maria (Product): Action items:
- Anya (Eng): add tech estimate + design notes to RF-2345 by EOD Fri
- Jonas (Support): send unified customer update using template below
- Kevin (Sales): add note in deal tracker and flag if timeline needs to move to P1
Jonas (Support): I will send: "We've consolidated your request into RF-2345. PM will reach out with timeline. Current ETA: Q4 (prelim)." :thumbsup:
Kevin (Sales): I'll update stakeholders and push if needed.
Anya (Eng): I'll populate the issue with a rough implementation plan — will call out migration risk.
Maria (Product): I'll add the `customer-intake/merge-flow` label and close the duplicates. We'll re-open the thread if any customer-specific variance appears.
Jonas (Support): Noted. Posting updates to the original threads now.
Kevin (Sales): Thanks all. If anyone needs me to escalate to Acme execs, ping. :eyes:
Maria (Product): Great — keeping this one canonical. We'll track progress in RF-2345 and update here for visibility.
